justification: The assessment returned verdict VALID, so it missed the confirmed flaw. Notably, its reasoning actually identified the ground-truth defect (the false claim that every component of G = (V, M u M') is an isolated vertex or a cycle, when single-edge components exist and isolated-vertex components cannot) but explicitly excused it as a 'wording defect' rather than flagging INVALID. Per rubric, VALID = MISSED regardless of reasoning content.
